question: What was the objective of the study on PCOS?
answer: The objective was to study the cardiometabolic markers in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) across all phenotypes and its correlation with serum anti-mullerian hormone (AMH) levels. [Source: Cardiometabolic markers and serum amh levels in PCOS - PubMed] Please consult a healthcare provider for personalized advice.
